title: Assessing the scope as well as the specificity of a delegation
shortTitle: Assessing the scope as well as the specificity of a delegation
summary: A delegation can be evaluated by both how precisely Congress directs decisions and how widely the delegated power reaches.
notes:
Guidance concerns the criteria an administrator must use; scope concerns the regulated parties, activities, and range of legal obligations the administrator may impose. Whitman expressly recognizes that a broader delegation calls for greater guidance. Coglianese’s assigned argument uses this distinction to reconcile Schechter with later cases sustaining broadly worded standards.

On that account, authority over nearly every industry and economic practice differs from authority over air pollution even when both have economy-wide consequences. Coglianese acknowledges difficulty fitting Panama Refining into the explanation. The dimensional approach is an attributed scholarly interpretation of the cases, not a separately adopted universal test.
